title: Maieutic Prompting: Logically Consistent Reasoning with Recursive Explanations
reasoning: The paper develops a method inspired by the Socratic maieutic method to improve logical consistency in language models. While the inspiration comes from a philosophical method, the application is purely on enhancing the reasoning and consistency of LMs for QA tasks, not on evaluating or benchmarking ethical principles, moral reasoning, or religious/faith-based content directly.
